original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can scripts/exclusion_circuit.py:ExclusionCircuit.compile / verify_embedding accelerate the post-#2001 residual (parallel edge0/edge1 slot maps; pivot-first nesting without set(ins+outs); dense descendant array) so compile maps and verify_embedding receipts stay fieldwise identical on the historical n=45 circuit, without changing ExclusionCircuit.verify or the closed-form reverse/leave-two masks?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering (seed a85f20f2e9b661a9314bb2e14f07eb84) after leave-alone overlap ruled out mixed-point Circuit.verify (#2150), DisjointTensor.frame_data (#2117), ternary frames (#2100), SharedPoint init (#2054), and joint-frames (#1922). Profiling named ExclusionCircuit(45).verify_embedding's compile + nesting residual after the merged #2001 reverse-frame masks.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: ExclusionCircuit embedding checks feed positive-side, dyadic-central, ternary-side and disjoint-tensor certificates inside verify-certificates. A faster identical embedding path does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving compile/verify_embedding residual rewrite with frozen baseline, identical compile maps and embedding receipts, registered replay and a measured before/after median at or above the ~1.5× tooling bar. Do not reopen leave-alone PRs, invent kappa, or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_EXCLUSION_EMBEDDING_COMPILE via research/exclusion-embedding-compile/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_EXCLUSION_EMBEDDING_COMPILE_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; four certificates differ from base only in the scripts/exclusion_circuit.py source pin.

open_questions.first_step: Propose a non-blocking timer on ExclusionCircuit(45).compile in the existing research-packages workflow after this PR lands.
